title: "Forecasting Influenza Admissions"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(pacman)
p_load(readr, dplyr, lubridate, forecast)


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast)
```

```{r paths}
input_csv <- "../output/data/01_cleaning/cleaned_flu_admissions.csv"
output_csv <- "../output/data/03_forecast/forecast.csv"
output_plot <- "../output/figures/03_forecast/forecast.png"

for (dir_path in c(dirname(output_csv), dirname(output_plot))) {
  dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load-and-validate}
raw_data <- read_csv(input_csv, col_types = cols(week = col_date(), location = col_character(), value = col_double()))

if (!"week" %in% names(raw_data) || !inherits(raw_data$week, "Date")) {
  raw_data$week <- tryCatch(as.Date(raw_data$week), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(raw_data$week) || !inherits(raw_data$week, "Date")) {
    stop("The week could not be parsed.")
  }
}

if (!"location" %in% names(raw_data)) {
  stop("The location could not be parsed.")
}
raw_data$location <- as.character(raw_data$location)
if (any(raw_data$location != "US")) {
  stop("The location could not be parsed.")
}

if (!"value" %in% names(raw_data) || !is.numeric(raw_data$value)) {
  raw_data$value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw_data$value))
  if (!is.numeric(raw_data$value)) {
    stop("The value could not be parsed.")
  }
}
```

```{r prepare-series}
series <- raw_data %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  select(week, value)

if (nrow(series) < 2) {
  stop("Not enough data for forecasting.")
}

horizon <- 4
n_total <- nrow(series)
test_start_index <- n_total - horizon + 1
training_end_index <- test_start_index - 1

training_data <- series[1:training_end_index, , drop = FALSE]
test_data <- series[test_start_index:n_total, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r forecast}
forecast_rows <- vector("list", horizon)

for (i in seq_len(horizon)) {
  target_date <- test_data$week[i]
  reference_date <- target_date - days(7)

  if (!inherits(reference_date, "Date") || !inherits(target_date, "Date")) {
    stop("reference_date or target date is not a Date object.")
  }

  training_window <- series %>%
    filter(week <= reference_date)

  if (max(training_window$week) >= target_date) {
    stop("Training window contains look-ahead leakage.")
  }

  model <- auto.arima(training_window$value)
  fc <- forecast(model, h = 1)

  forecast_rows[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(
    target_date = target_date,
    reference_date = reference_date,
    forecast_value = as.numeric(fc$mean[1]),
    actual_value = test_data$value[i]
  )
}

forecast_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(forecast_rows)
forecast_df$target_date <- as.Date(forecast_df$target_date)
forecast_df$reference_date <- as.Date(forecast_df$reference_date)
```

```{r validations}
cat("Training Period start date:", format(min(training_data$week), "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
cat("Rolling window end dates:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(test_data))) {
  cat("  ", format(test_data$week[i], "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
}
cat("Testing Period start date:", format(min(test_data$week), "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
cat("Forecast dates:\n")
#for (date in forecast_df$target_date) {
#  cat("  ", format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
#}

for (i in 1:nrow(forecast_df)) {
  date <- forecast_df$forecast_date[i]
  cat(" ", format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"), "\n")
}

cat("Forecasting horizon:", horizon, "\n")

if (!all(vapply(forecast_df$reference_date, inherits, logical(1), "Date"))) {
  stop("The reference_date could not be parsed.")
}
if (!all(vapply(forecast_df$target_date, inherits, logical(1), "Date"))) {
  stop("The target_date could not be parsed.")
}
if (!all(as.numeric(forecast_df$target_date - forecast_df$reference_date) == 7)) {
  stop("The target/reference date difference is not exactly 7 days for every row.")
}
if (any(max(training_window$week) >= forecast_df$target_date)) {
  stop("Forecasting uses look-ahead leakage.")
}
```

```{r save-output}
forecast_df <- forecast_df %>%
  mutate(
    target_date = format(target_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    reference_date = format(reference_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
  )

write_csv(forecast_df, output_csv)

png(filename = output_plot, width = 1600, height = 900, res = 200)
plot(
  x = as.Date(forecast_df$target_date),
  y = forecast_df$forecast_value,
  type = "b",
  pch = 16,
  col = "blue",
  main = "Forecast of Influenza Admissions",
  xlab = "target date",
  ylab = "forecast"
)
dev.off()
```
